procedure: For each nominated anchor, a one-line English summary of the information the recording carries was written first.

The Filipino query was written from that summary only, as a topic or information need a searcher could ask without knowing the sentence, avoiding the anchor's wording and its proper names where possible.

The lexical-overlap audit (tools/audit_audio_queries.py; normalised tokens longer than three characters) was run against all 120 references; queries over the declared threshold were rewritten before freezing.

Query IDs, anchors, target families and the development/evaluation split were kept from ai-draft-v1; queries, anchors and the null relevance matrix were frozen before any system was run on this version.
limitations: One AI-assisted author saw each reference sentence when writing its summary; the summary step is not an independent elicitation.
Draft pending native-speaker review: Filipino naturalness, answerability and whether each query still identifies its anchor have not been checked by a competent speaker.
Topic-level queries may be satisfied by other recordings; every relevance cell remains unjudged.
